description: Shared conformance corpus for result-status semantics (PAR-RESULT-SEMANTICS, P3). Consumed by runtime/lib/result.test.mjs (node) and, since M3.1, by runtime/lib/result.conformance.test.ps1 (pwsh reference implementation, runtime/lib/result.ps1) -- both must pass the same cases.

forbiddenPatterns.description: TEMPLATE v2.0.5 check-status.ps1 prints the literal 'PASS STATUS.md coherente (warnings regenerables)' and exits 0 even with warnings. formatLine() never returns the bare literal 'PASS' when warnings > 0; it returns 'PASS_WITH_WARNINGS (...)' instead.

TEMPLATE v2.0.5 check-status.ps1 -Json always exits 0 even when INCONSISTENTE. exitCodeFor() takes no output-format parameter, so there is no code path that can silently return 0 regardless of status.

TEMPLATE v2.0.5 check-integrity.ps1 treats a stale STATUS.md as a warning-only condition that still prints PASS at exit 0. Under this module, any warning forces PASS_WITH_WARNINGS, and CI (strict=true) exits non-zero on it.
